abstract: A 25-year-old woman had a malignant ovarian tumor with two distinct tumor patterns: pseudomucinous cystadenocarcinoma and malignant giant cell tumor of bone. One area of the tumor had a lining of tall columnar epithelium with abundant mucin production; however, another area of the same tumor had a number of large multinucleated giant cells that resembled osteoclasts, intermingled with mononuclear stromal cells. There was no blending of the two tumor patterns. Mitoses were frequent in both areas. A probable histogenesis of the tumor from a malignant teratoma is suggested.
abstract_ja: 25歳女性に、偽粘液性嚢胞腺癌と悪性巨細胞性腫瘍(骨の巨細胞腫様)の2つの明瞭な腫瘍パターンを示す悪性卵巣腫瘍を認めた。一方の領域は多量の粘液を産生する高円柱上皮で覆われ、もう一方の領域には破骨細胞様の多数の大型多核巨細胞が間質の単核細胞と混在していた。両パターンは混和していなかった。両領域とも核分裂像が多く認められた。本腫瘍は悪性奇形腫から組織発生した可能性が示唆される。
